verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's first-party docs describe creating scoped API keys with only the permissions a workload needs, via `vastai create api-key`, for CI/CD, automation and shared tooling. This directly fits issuing least-privilege credentials to an agent alongside its documented vastai agent skill. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the permission model (which scopes or resources can be restricted), any agent-specific guidance on scoping keys, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
